paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: Probing accuracy with reduced training data.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between train size and accuracy for two different models, mBERT and XLM-R. The x-axis is labeled “Train size” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 2000, with tick labels displayed at 250, 500, 750, 1000, 1250, 1500, 1750 and 2000. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy” with a linear scale ranging from 80 to 94, with tick labels displayed at 80, 82, 84, 86, 88, 90, 92 and 94.  A blue line, representing mBERT, is plotted with an 'x' marker; it starts at approximately 84.5 when the Train size is 0, increases to approximately 87.5 when the Train size is 250, then plateaus around 88.5 from a Train size of 1250 to 2000. A dark blue line, representing XLM-R, is plotted with an 'x' marker; it starts at approximately 85 when the Train size is 0, increases to approximately 89 when the Train size is 250, then plateaus around 91 from a Train size of 1250 to 2000.
